'''Needlefish''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] that lived in the [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[seatree]] [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of the [[Mkbuto Seatree Preserve]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The Preserve hosted a delicate ecosystem that, in addition to the needlefish, was home to [[tumblebasker]]s and [[blossoming gulper]]s.<ref name="GatORW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Needlefish were mentioned in the [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''.<ref name="GatORW" />
